text:
Jake (Acme): Hey, we set data retention to 30 days on our account last month but noticed user data for a few records still present after ~45 days. Can someone confirm deletion timeline and whether backups/kms can keep copies beyond retention? This is urgent for compliance (GDPR).

Olivia - Customer Success: Sorry you're seeing that, Jake. Can you DM the sample record IDs? I'll open an escalation.

Jake (Acme): Sent the IDs in DM (ids: user_9923, session_88f). Also saw an audit log entry ~2026-02-14 showing "retention_policy.update" but no deletion events around 30d expiry.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Thanks. Opening a support ticket: INC-20260317-42. Adding details here for visibility. First-pass checklist: retention policy attached to account? backups retention policy? legal holds? KMS key state?

Support Bot: Ticket created INC-20260317-42 and assigned to Priya Patel.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Quick answers/reporting: I pulled the account policy via API: `GET /v1/accounts/{acct}/retention` returned `{"retention_period_days":30,"applies_to":"default","last_updated":"2026-01-15T12:04:18Z"}`. The expiry for user_9923 should have been ~2026-02-14. No deletion event in the retention log for that key.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Repro steps I'm running now (internal): 1) fetch object metadata 2) check deletion scheduler logs 3) check snapshot/backup inventory 4) check audit logs for `data.delete` events 5) check KMS key status and scheduled rotations.

Mark Li - Eng-Security: Looping in eng-security. Two quick things that cause "deleted but appears present": a) object exists in long-term backups (S3 Glacier etc.) b) encryption key re-wrap/backups keep ciphertext in backups outside standard retention. We need to confirm whether the backup lifecycle for this account is separate from retention.

Mark Li - Eng-Security: @Priya can you paste the storage bucket and snapshot prefixes? I'll query backup inventory for backups that include user_9923.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Bucket: rdinference-prod-backups/account-134; snapshot prefix: acct-134/snap-2026-01*. Searching now.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Found snap `acct-134/snap-2026-01-20-utc` that references user_9923. That snapshot is part of our monthly archive group with 365d lifecycle by mistake (should have inherited account retention). Investigating why inheritance failed.

Olivia - Customer Success: Jake, this looks like the cause — an archive snapshot with longer retention. We're treating as incident until we get confirmation deletion occurred end-to-end.

Jake (Acme): Is there an immediate workaround to purge that snapshot? We need proof of deletion for auditors.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Two paths: 1) If legal hold not present, we can schedule targeted purge of the snapshot (manual delete + S3 lifecycle override). That will trigger a `data.delete` audit event and we can provide log entry. 2) If KMS/HSM rules require key unwrapping before deletion, we may need Eng-Security signoff. Which do you prefer?

Jake (Acme): We have no legal hold. Please purge and provide the audit evidence.

Mark Li - Eng-Security: Confirmed no legal hold flagged for these objects. KMS key for account-134 (alias/rdi/acct-134) is active and not scheduled for deletion or rotation. Purge OK from a key-policy point of view. I'll approve manual purge and will audit logs for the `kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion` etc.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Performing manual purge of snap acct-134/snap-2026-01-20-utc now. Command run: ``
aws s3api delete-object --bucket rdinference-prod-backups --key "acct-134/snap-2026-01-20-utc/objects/user_9923.json" 
``

Priya Patel - Support L2: Also kicked deletion job for the full snapshot prefix to ensure no residual copies. Job ID: purge-job-8842. ETA ~45min.

Support Bot: purge-job-8842 status: queued -> running.

Priya Patel - Support L2: For audit, expect two entries when complete: `data.delete` with request_id `req-0c9a7f` and `retention.purge_completed` with job id purge-job-8842. I'll post the event JSON here when we see it.

security-bot: Alert: KMS access log shows `Encrypt` calls for key alias/rdi/acct-134 around 2026-01-20. No `ScheduleKeyDeletion` or `DisableKey` events found.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Purge-job running. Checking backups for additional snapshots referencing same objects to avoid leftovers.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Purge-job-8842: completed. Observed audit events: `{"event":"data.delete","object":"user_9923","request_id":"req-0c9a7f","time":"2026-03-17T14:35:12Z"}` and `{"event":"retention.purge_completed","job_id":"purge-job-8842","time":"2026-03-17T14:36:22Z"}`.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Verified no active copies in archive inventory. Final check: `GET /v1/audit?object=user_9923` returned deletion event above plus `retention_policy.update` from earlier.

Olivia - Customer Success: Jake — we've completed the purge and attached the audit event JSON to ticket INC-20260317-42. You should have the proof for auditors. Do you need a signed attestation?

Jake (Acme): Thanks team — can you also confirm deletion propagation to any downstream indices (search, embeddings)? I still see a search result for user_9923 in our app's index.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Good catch. That is likely application-side embedding index not automatically cleaned up. We will: 1) invalidate cached embeddings via `POST /v1/embeddings/invalidate` for object user_9923 2) emit `index.delete` event for downstream systems. Running now.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Emitted `index.delete` and `embeddings.invalidate` events. Audit entries: `{"event":"index.delete","object":"user_9923","time":"2026-03-17T14:42:01Z"}`. If you still see results in 15-30 minutes, clear local caches and re-query.

Jake (Acme): Verified — search result cleared after cache flush. All good. Thank you. :raised_hands: 

Mark Li - Eng-Security: Postmortem notes: root cause was archive snapshot lifecycle misconfiguration. Action items: 1) ensure retention inheritance enforced for snapshot lifecycle (policy PR #rdi-556) 2) add a periodic audit that flags objects with expiry > account retention 3) add soft-delete markers in snapshots to make purges safer.

Priya Patel - Support L2: Closing INC-20260317-42 after confirmation. I'll attach timeline, audit JSONs, and the PR reference.

Olivia - Customer Success: Thanks everyone — Jake if anything else pops up ping me.

Jake (Acme): Appreciate the quick turnaround.
